title: W7 R2 -- Preserve boxes on Page setup dropdowns
description: Repair finding from T239: Lane B's broad format-bar dropdown border reset also matches the Page setup popover's Paper size and Page margins dropdowns because the popover is rendered as a descendant of the format bar. Preserve the existing boxes for those popover controls while keeping the three requested top-bar dropdowns (zoom, paragraph style, font) unboxed. Add a regression assertion in editor-toolbar.spec.ts for Page setup Paper size and Page margins borders, plus verify target controls remain unboxed and focus outlined. Fail-first should show Page setup controls report zero borders under the current broad rule although they had the base dropdown border before; run the targeted editor-toolbar spec on a fresh built private dist with serial-check.lock. Do not change the screenplay paragraph-style dropdown (it is part of the requested text type control).

handoff.text: Rejected on reading alone: nothing was run, because agent-3100 (T240 chromium) held serial-check.lock for my full 15 minute wait. Failing check: zoom, paragraph style and font must stay borderless when the More menu holds them. Mechanism: .writer .format-bar .toolbar-popover .dropdown-button also matches the More popover (class toolbar-popover is-more), and OVERFLOW_ORDER moves font, paragraph (with the screenplay dropdown) and zoom into it via renderGroup(group, true), so they get the 1px box back. They were borderless in More under the broad rule alone, so this is a T241 regression. Suggested fix, untested: scope the rule to .writer .format-bar .toolbar-popover-body .dropdown-button; Paper size and Page margins sit in .toolbar-popover-body and More-held groups do not. Test to add in tests/editor-toolbar.spec.ts: narrow the bar until the triggers overflow, open More, assert 0px on Editor zoom, Paragraph style and Font family, plus Screenplay paragraph style under the Screenplay template; keep the Page setup test. Width at which they overflow is inferred, not measured. Page setup box match (hover, focus, open, dark) looks correct on reading and fail-first2.log is valid. Scope call: this reads 'top bar' as including these controls in More; if the coordinator means the visible bar only, T241 can be approved as is. Details: docs/agent-work/2026-11-04-ui-wave-7/REVIEW-r3.md, section T241.

review.note: Approved, CLAIMED (Chromium only). Fresh build: tests/editor-toolbar.spec.ts 17 passed (ui7-rv-final/run.log). Probe (probe.log): Page setup Paper size and Page margins 1px at 1900 (bar), 1280, 850, 700, 600 (More); screenplay dropdown 0px on the bar and in More; spec covers zoom, paragraph style, font at 1280 and 460. No other toolbar-popover-body panel holds a Dropdown. Fail-first valid: failfirst2.log ran on the 07:43 pre-fix dist, 1px on Editor zoom. Removed Page setup step: acceptable, wide test covers the rule; it timed out because at 520 and 460 px the More row sits under the sidebar's Settings group, below the 850 minimum window and not from this CSS. Details: REVIEW-r3.md, Final.

log.note: Scoped .writer .format-bar .dropdown-button border reset (src/editor/editor.css) so zoom, paragraph style and font triggers stay unboxed; added .writer .format-bar .toolbar-popover .dropdown-button { border: 1px solid var(--line) } so Page setup Paper size and Page margins keep their box. Added test 'Page setup Paper size and Page margins keep their 1 px box' in tests/editor-toolbar.spec.ts. Fail-first (ui7-t241/fail-first2.log): Paper size and Page margins reported 0px borders, 1 failed / 20 passed. Final (ui7-t241/final.log): editor-toolbar + popover-bounds 21 passed, PW EXIT 0. tsc --noEmit exit 0 (ui7-t241/tsc.log). Nothing committed.
